title: Law to require clean sidewalk and roadway cafe setups
summary: This bill would require operators of roadway and sidewalk cafes to keep their outdoor setups clear of trash, debris, graffiti, vermin, food scraps and unsanitary conditions, including within an 18-inch radius of the cafe. Violations would carry civil penalties of $300 for a first offense and $600 for a second or later offense at the same location. The law would take effect 120 days after passage.
